Sweetness in people feels similar, soft and harmless, just like fruit. But fruit ripens toward rot, and sweetness carries its own price. Some desires bite back. We reach for beauty hoping it will soothe us, fill us, make us whole. Yet beautiful things can devour as easily as they delight. Desire is a creature with its own appetite.
